newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ to restructure Esanda finance.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ to restructure Esanda finance.

text.p: The Australia and New Zealand (ANZ) Banking Group Ltd would restructure its Esanda financing unit into two different areas and lay off a significant number of staff, an ANZ spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
"The whole structure is being reviewed. We need to increase the competitiveness and growth prospects of Esanda," an ANZ spokeswoman told Reuters.
The spokeswoman said, however, that newspaper reports saying Esanda would shed 40 percent or 700 of its staff were incorrect.

She said ANZ would separate Esanda into a Chattel finance arm, which covered leases secured by assets like houses, and a customer focused leasing and finance arm, where leases were not secured by such assets.
The restructure of Esanda was part of a global reorganisation.
"Esanda is one part of a global change, particularly in the retail and international services areas," the spokeswoman said.
